infoCards.title: Logistics Control
infoCards.description: Comprehensive logistics and supply chain management system.

faqData.question: How does the system handle multi-location inventory?
faqData.answer: Our system provides real-time inventory tracking across multiple locations with automated replenishment, transfer management and optimized stock levels based on demand patterns.

faqData.question: What order processing features are included?
faqData.answer: The system includes comprehensive order management with bulk processing, automated fulfillment, pricing management and real-time status tracking across the supply chain.

faqData.question: Can it manage customer relationships?
faqData.answer: Yes, our solution includes advanced CRM features with customer segmentation, pricing tiers, credit management and detailed transaction history tracking.
